sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Combine those building blocks — not just single words in isolation, but identity and existence inside real sentences about people.

Ő a testvérem. identifies someone (zero copula, plus the possessive -m on testvér), and itt van a család. reports where the family is (van, since this is location, not identity). Notice both drop straight into a natural exchange — 'who's that?' / 'is everyone here?' — without a verb paradigm in sight.
